atAGlance: Cơm chiên trứng is egg fried rice, usually with egg, scallion, garlic, and grains fried until separate.
whatItIs: Cơm chiên trứng is egg fried rice, usually just rice, egg, scallions, garlic, and wok seasoning. Its simplicity makes texture important.
howToEnjoy: Eat it while the grains are hot and separate, with egg coating the rice instead of clumping. Add chili only if you want heat, not because the dish needs rescuing.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm chiên trứng when you want the simplest fried rice. Ask ít dầu, thêm trứng, or không cay before the wok starts.
worthKnowing: This can be a safe fallback order for travelers, but a good shop still makes it fragrant with egg, scallion, and hot wok breath.
goodToKnow: This is a simple wok-rice order, often chosen when you want something quick, hot, and not too heavy. The egg should coat the grains lightly.
